intervals.note: Start of construction is not sourced; a 2013 design paper describes the array as 'under construction' at that time. Full-array completion/operations start is dated to March 2015 by a 2025 collaboration paper ('completed in early 2015' per a 2017 paper).

name: Sierra Negra (HAWC site)
notes: The official hawc-observatory.org site could not be fetched (TLS certificate verification failed on every attempt, checked 2026-09-17); all facts come from collaboration arXiv papers instead.

altitude.quote: under construction 4100 meters above sea level at Sierra Negra, Mexico

summary.plain: A gamma-ray observatory on the slopes of the Sierra Negra volcano in Mexico, high enough (4100 metres) that ground-based tanks of water can catch particle showers from gamma rays hitting the atmosphere.
summary.technical: High-altitude gamma-ray observatory site on Sierra Negra, Puebla, Mexico, at 4100 m altitude; hosts the HAWC water-Cherenkov array, operating since March 2015.
